name: 18031 · Breinigsville, PA
findings: ZIP 18031 (Breinigsville) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18031 (Breinigsville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 18031 (Breinigsville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
